svg.aria-label: The ordo-init skill in an existing repository with no plan.yaml. Boxes: The form and the roadmap file drafted (a step of the session); Several roadmaps (stop); The verification page, the rules page and the roots drafted, each command run once (a step of the session); A failing command (stop); Worker, reviewer and libraries (stop); The questions (stop); The glossary, the optional keys, the ignore rules and the shared rules drafted (a step of the session); The draft of the configuration (stop); The approved files written (a step of the session); templates/check_config.py, then templates/sync_rules.py over the two blocks (script); A fix in the configuration check (stop); A hunk to rule on (stop); The drafted sync change (stop); A file sync cannot use (stop); The sync still fails (stop); One commit of the files written (a step of the session); No commit allowed (stop).

svg.text: In an empty folder the skill sets up a new repository from the questions and the draft of the tree; with a plan.yaml it checks the configuration and syncs the two blocks; build writes utils/build.py from the verification page.

svg.text: --ruling writes a ruled draft without its stop. The skill starts no agent, and the refusals are not drawn.
